patch_description: This crossover retains the strongest validated elements: globally shared local rotations, complete-graph CZ entanglement aligned with all 28 feature-pair channels, and the central trainable CRZ interaction. It also incorporates the faster-converging dual-axis post-mixing idea by adding a shared RX layer tied to the existing central interaction parameter. This preserves four parameters per block and 26 total parameters while adding noncommuting basis conversion without increasing parameter count. The resulting ansatz remains strongly regularized and permutation-oriented, but has a richer path for converting encoded phases into mean-Z signals.
